classification.added_after_source499: Three reveal/self-reference cases and a stronger historical self-reference assertion validate lifecycle and cyclic identity without changing production code.

limits: Chosen modes, directions, parity, sectors, types, colors, names, number, commander color, chosen-player/card/group state are explicit native metadata. Raw assignments and six-zone contracts are not added Oracle text.
Card and player references use the shared entity map, including historical timestamps and eliminated registered players. Snapshot and native LKI paths use the same routine.

Public presentation is copied separately from rules values; revealing a copy does not reveal the original. Mutable color/name/group containers are separate while their intra-card view aliasing is retained.
The Persecute control supplies its color and resolves actual native paid effects. These checks do not establish autonomous strategy for every color/name/player choice.

No changes to user input formats, native rules definitions, AI search budgets, heap or worker limits. Selected contracts and catalog construction do not certify complete cards, arbitrary state graphs or multiplayer strategy.
